a.lede: Amazon-owned Ring is entering the smart lock market with a device designed to tackle a common concern: getting locked out when the battery dies.
a.title: Ring’s first smart lock can be hand-cranked when its battery dies

b.lede: Ring's smart lock has a built-in hand crank to generate power when the batteries are dead.
b.title: Ring's smart lock has a hand crank so it works even if the power's out
